title: Great Salt Lake and Antelope Island Day Tour
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
With an experienced guide to help bring the story of the Great Salt Lake and Antelope Island to life, you’ll have plenty of time to experience the largest island in the Great Salt Lake, as you hike and explore this unique and timeless landscape. Each season of the year offers a different experience. More importantly you will learn more about the issues and struggles that are affecting the lake and the work that is being done to conserve this priceless resource.

Enjoy a more personal experience with our small-group tour (minimum of 2 guests required). Join us for this 5 ½ hour Great Salt Lake Tour. Your Adventure Awaits!
